name: Holocron VR
shortDescription: Explore your codebase as an immersive 3D VR constellation powered by Graphify knowledge graphs.
longDescription:
Transform YodaMan's Graphify knowledge graphs into an explorable 3D constellation. Navigate 3,000+ nodes in VR at 72 FPS with SIMD-accelerated WASM layout, use natural-language voice commands, ask YodaMan's AI agent to explain any file's architecture role, and keep your code 100% local — zero data ever leaves your machine.

Desktop 3D mode works with mouse and keyboard — no headset required.

Key features:
- Desktop 3D and VR modes (Meta Quest 2/3/Pro via WebXR)
- Voice commands: "Where is AuthService", "Show me payment", "Hide tests"
- AI agent integration: click "Ask Agent" for architectural explanations
- Smart filtering: hide tests, third-party code, generated files, or show only recent changes
- Save/restore views as YodaMan tasks
- Open files in VS Code with one click
- LOD system for smooth performance on 3,000+ node codebases
